scope: R07 Home relocation and successful fine02, preserving failed fine01 and incomplete baseline.

same_corner_before_after_sequence.scope: Difference spans interrupted scan, two withdrawals, elapsed time, Home relocation and two fine engagements. No exclusive action or chemical cause assigned.

comparison_to_fine01.limitations: Position and elapsed time changed together. Corner recovery supports a role for local site and/or time dependence, without isolating the cause or proving tip repair.

limits: No high-rate XY channel is present, so the native current/Z trace alone does not prove the lateral trajectory. Actual known move ACK and5s stationary readbacks independently establish the endpoint.
Signal names and units are preserved. ZControl is an absolute-current-valued signal and its match to Current is not an independent sensor validation. ZError transfer function remains uncalibrated.
Fine02 success is sampled current stability at a fixed corner. Z creep and image quality are separately recorded. No complete new baseline has yet been established by this result.
Partial scan failure, fine01 failure and all earlier claims remain in the history.
